name: ton-ai-durev-radar
description: Rebuild scripts for the durev engine stack

scripts.clean: npm run clean:rust && npm run clean:ts
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build plugins/durevcode/rust --target web --out-dir ../wasm --out-name durev_wasm -- --no-default-features --features wasm
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run rebuild:quick
scripts.rebuild:all: npm run clean && npm run build:rust && npm run build:durevcode && npm run build:agent && npm run test:rust && npm run test:ts
scripts.rebuild:quick: npm run build:rust && npm run build:durevcode && npm run build:agent

author: TON AI Core Team
